package java.lang;

import java.util.List;
import java.util.Random;
import java.util.stream.IntStream;

/**
 * Stock-JVM proof of the growing-window linear search of M3StringPositionPrecompute. PositionKernel
 * (head) and PositionKernelBase (base) are generated by run_proof.sh: the method text is copied
 * from the two sources, never retyped. This class lives in java.lang of a patched stock JDK so
 * the copied text links against the stock StringLatin1 and StringUTF16 helpers; M3String is the
 * proof stub. Oracle: a naive scan of the char array. Prints one row per check: name, cases,
 * mismatches. Exit 1 on a mismatch or a surviving discriminator.
 */
public final class PositionKernelProof {
    private static final List<Integer> LENGTHS = List.of(
            0, 1, 2, 31, 32, 33, 95, 96, 97, 223, 224, 225, 479, 480, 481, 991, 992, 993, 2015,
            2016, 2017, 4063, 4064, 4065, 8159, 8160, 8161, 12255, 12256, 12257);
    private static final int SWEEP_ALL_BELOW = 300;
    private static final int RANDOM_CASES = 20_000;
    private static final int RANDOM_MAX_LENGTH = 9_000;
    private static final long SEED = 20261116L;
    private static final char TARGET = 'x';
    private static final char WIDE = (char) 0x100;
    private static final int FIRST_WINDOW = 32;
    private static int failures;

    private PositionKernelProof() {}

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        report("single_hit_sweep_latin1", sweep(String.LATIN1));
        report("single_hit_sweep_utf16", sweep(String.UTF16));
        report("random_vs_oracle_and_base", random());
        report("latin1_gate_reads_nothing", latin1Gate());
        report("forward_copy_bound_2d_plus_32", copyBound());
        // The linear kernels serve sources under 256 and over 32,768 units; 4,000 is kernel-only.
        List.of(200, 4_000, 40_000).forEach(length -> {
            long[] split = splitScenario(length, 8);
            System.out.println("split_scenario_units_copied\tlength=" + length + "\tbase=" + split[0]
                    + "\thead=" + split[1]);
            failures += split[1] < split[0] ? 0 : 1;
        });
        discriminator("mutant_advance_by_window_size", sweepDetectsMutant());
        System.out.println("RESULT\t" + (failures == 0 ? "PASS" : "FAIL") + "\tfailures=" + failures);
        System.exit(failures == 0 ? 0 : 1);
    }

    private static M3String text(int length, int hit, byte coder) {
        char[] units = new char[length];
        java.util.Arrays.fill(units, 'a');
        if (hit >= 0) units[hit] = TARGET;
        return new M3String(units, coder);
    }

    /** Every position for short texts; the neighbourhood of every window seam for long ones. */
    private static IntStream positions(int length) {
        IntStream seams = LENGTHS.stream().flatMapToInt(seam -> IntStream.rangeClosed(seam - 2, seam + 2));
        IntStream all = length <= SWEEP_ALL_BELOW ? IntStream.range(0, length)
                : IntStream.concat(seams, IntStream.of(0, length - 1, length - 33, length - 32));
        return all.filter(position -> position >= 0 && position < length).distinct();
    }

    private static long[] sweep(byte coder) {
        long[] counts = new long[2];
        LENGTHS.forEach(length -> positions(length).forEach(hit -> {
            counts[0]++;
            counts[1] += oneHit(length, hit, coder) ? 0 : 1;
        }));
        return counts;
    }

    private static boolean oneHit(int length, int hit, byte coder) {
        return PositionKernel.first(text(length, hit, coder), TARGET, 0, length) == hit
                && PositionKernel.first(text(length, hit, coder), TARGET, hit + 1, length) == -1
                && PositionKernel.first(text(length, hit, coder), TARGET, 0, hit) == -1
                && PositionKernel.last(text(length, hit, coder), TARGET, length - 1) == hit
                && PositionKernel.last(text(length, hit, coder), TARGET, hit - 1) == -1;
    }

    private static long[] random() {
        Random random = new Random(SEED);
        long mismatches = IntStream.range(0, RANDOM_CASES).filter(index -> !randomCase(random)).count();
        return new long[] {RANDOM_CASES, mismatches};
    }

    private static boolean randomCase(Random random) {
        byte coder = random.nextBoolean() ? String.LATIN1 : String.UTF16;
        char[] alphabet = {'a', 'b', TARGET, coder == String.UTF16 ? WIDE : 'c'};
        char[] units = new char[random.nextInt(RANDOM_MAX_LENGTH + 1)];
        int density = 1 + random.nextInt(2_000);
        IntStream.range(0, units.length).forEach(index -> units[index] =
                random.nextInt(density) == 0 ? alphabet[2 + random.nextInt(2)] : alphabet[random.nextInt(2)]);
        char unit = alphabet[2 + random.nextInt(2)];
        int from = units.length == 0 ? 0 : random.nextInt(units.length);
        int end = from + random.nextInt(units.length - from + 1);
        return forwardAgrees(units, coder, unit, from, end) && backwardAgrees(units, coder, unit, from);
    }

    private static boolean forwardAgrees(char[] units, byte coder, char unit, int from, int end) {
        int expected = IntStream.range(from, end).filter(index -> units[index] == unit)
                .findFirst().orElse(-1);
        return (from >= end || PositionKernel.first(new M3String(units, coder), unit, from, end) == expected)
                && (from >= end
                        || PositionKernelBase.first(new M3String(units, coder), unit, from, end) == expected);
    }

    private static boolean backwardAgrees(char[] units, byte coder, char unit, int from) {
        if (units.length == 0) return true;
        int expected = IntStream.rangeClosed(0, from).map(index -> from - index)
                .filter(index -> units[index] == unit).findFirst().orElse(-1);
        return PositionKernel.last(new M3String(units, coder), unit, from) == expected
                && PositionKernelBase.last(new M3String(units, coder), unit, from) == expected;
    }

    private static long[] latin1Gate() {
        M3String source = text(500, -1, String.LATIN1);
        boolean ok = PositionKernel.first(source, WIDE, 0, 500) == -1
                && PositionKernel.last(source, WIDE, 499) == -1 && source.windows == 0;
        return new long[] {2, ok ? 0 : 1};
    }

    /** A forward hit at distance d copies at most 2d + 32 units, whatever follows the hit. */
    private static long[] copyBound() {
        int length = 12_257;
        long mismatches = positions(length).filter(hit -> {
            M3String source = text(length, hit, String.UTF16);
            return PositionKernel.first(source, TARGET, 0, length) != hit
                    || source.copiedUnits > 2L * hit + FIRST_WINDOW;
        }).count();
        return new long[] {positions(length).count(), mismatches};
    }

    /** Units copied by a search-again-after-every-hit loop, as split(char) runs it. */
    private static long[] splitScenario(int length, int fieldUnits) {
        char[] units = new char[length];
        IntStream.range(0, length).forEach(index -> units[index] = index % fieldUnits == 0 ? TARGET : 'a');
        M3String base = new M3String(units, String.LATIN1);
        M3String head = new M3String(units, String.LATIN1);
        int[] offsets = {0, 0};
        while (offsets[0] >= 0) offsets[0] = next(PositionKernelBase.first(base, TARGET, offsets[0], length));
        while (offsets[1] >= 0) offsets[1] = next(PositionKernel.first(head, TARGET, offsets[1], length));
        return new long[] {base.copiedUnits, head.copiedUnits};
    }

    private static int next(int hit) {
        return hit < 0 ? -1 : hit + 1;
    }

    /** A wrong kernel that advances by the next window size must be caught by the sweep. */
    private static boolean sweepDetectsMutant() {
        return LENGTHS.stream().anyMatch(length -> positions(length)
                .anyMatch(hit -> mutantFirst(text(length, hit, String.LATIN1), length) != hit));
    }

    private static int mutantFirst(M3String source, int end) {
        int[] state = {0, FIRST_WINDOW, -1};
        while (state[0] < end && state[2] < 0) {
            int count = Math.min(state[1], end - state[0]);
            byte[] window = new byte[count];
            source.getBytes(window, state[0], 0, String.LATIN1, count);
            int index = StringLatin1.indexOf(window, TARGET, 0, count);
            state[2] = index < 0 ? -1 : state[0] + index;
            state[1] <<= 1;
            state[0] += state[1];
        }
        return state[2];
    }

    private static void report(String name, long[] counts) {
        failures += counts[1] == 0 ? 0 : 1;
        System.out.println(name + "\t" + counts[0] + "\t" + counts[1]);
    }

    private static void discriminator(String name, boolean detected) {
        failures += detected ? 0 : 1;
        System.out.println("discriminator:" + name + "\t1\t" + (detected ? "KILLED" : "SURVIVED"));
    }
}
